name: Mass Effect Legendary Edition
notes: Frostbite 3 DX11 → D3DMetal (Skyrim/FO4 class). Steam's default launch target is a link2ea:// EA App URL, not an exe. Launch MassEffectLauncher.exe (or MassEffect1/2/3.exe) with SteamAppId=1328670 so Steamworks still initialises. This is the Legendary Edition trilogy, not the 2012 originals. Pin CX_GRAPHICS_BACKEND=d3dmetal. Do not use Libraries.rgl or Libraries.vk.
